data.reasoning: The package is a standard binary distribution for JetBrains RustRover. The PKGBUILD downloads the official tarball from JetBrains over HTTPS and verifies it with a pinned b2sum checksum before installing it to /opt/rustrover. There are no malicious injections, no execution of fetched content, and no suspicious network requests. The disagreement was solely caused by an API error in the first model.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD and jetbrains-rustrover.desktop files, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and jetbrains-rustrover.desktop due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent partial audits from resulting in inconclusive verdicts for the entire package.
